findings.title: Mass assignment of is_admin via unguard() + request->all()
findings.description: User::unguard() disables the $fillable protection and User::create($request->all()) writes every submitted field, so a request body containing is_admin=1 (or any other column) is persisted, enabling privilege escalation. Remove unguard() and pass $request->only('name','email','password') or validated().
